_comment: Illustrated art the site may place on a page: ARCHV-drawn player portraits and ARCHV-designed club badges. Faces are illustrated-only by canon, and every badge here is our own typographic disc, never a club's real crest. Files live in public/media/illustrated/ and are committed at display size x2, compressed. Sources: portraits from fifa.archv/assets/headshots (see player-headshot-bank.md for the generation and QC record), badges from fifa.archv/match-covers/carousel/assets/badges (see that folder's MANIFEST.json). Read through scripts/shared/illustrated.mjs, never by hand-writing a path: phase 2B wires article templates to the same map.
